name: bobgo-shipping
description: Bob Go smart shipping solution for WooCommerce
author: Bob Group

scripts.assets:build: wp-scripts build assets/src/bobgo-shipping.js assets/src/checkout-suburb.js assets/src/custom-shipping-description.js --output-path=assets/build && rm ./assets/build/bobgo-shipping.asset.php && rm ./assets/build/checkout-suburb.asset.php && rm ./assets/build/custom-shipping-description.asset.php

hooks.pre-commit: npm config set git-tag-version false && npm version patch && npm run update-version-files && git add package.json bobgo-shipping.php readme.txt && pretty-quick --staged
